# Scope Reference

> Build a static, print-ready, Aleysian-branded scope reference from live scoping-app quotes.

**What it does.** : option cards plus a side-by-side line-item matrix with hours and in, available, optional, or out states, every item, hour, and price validated 1:1 before rendering.

**Use it when.** For a scope reference, option summary, scope comparison, option matrix, what is included, tier comparison, or a flat client leave-behind that shows the full matrix at once.

**Not for.** Do NOT use for a clickable or interactive proposal or a version switcher where the prospect moves through versions one at a time (that is interactive-proposal), the DDOC decision deck (ddoc), the SOW contract (sow), or creating and editing the quote itself (scoping-agent).
